title: Sebulba
subtitle: Independent
description: An especially dangerous Dug, Sebulba was a hotshot Podracer pilot who wasn't above cheating in matches to come out on top in every race. That was until he tried to sabotage Anakin Skywalker's Podracer at the Boonta Eve Classic. Skywalker was able to advance despite Sebulba's insidious tactics, and cause him to crash his own Podracer, costing him -and others betting on the race- a lot of money.
